preconditions.description: The length of the string s is even.
The length of the string s matches the given n.
The string s consists of only lowercase Latin letters.
The length of the beauty list b matches the given n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= 100 for bi in b)
preconditions.description: Each beauty value in b is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(t[i] != t[n - i - 1] for i in range(n // 2))
all(c in s for c in t)
postconditions.description: The string t is a permutation of the string s.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(b[i] for i in range(n) if s[i] == t[i])
postconditions.description: The return value is the maximum possible beauty of t.
